name: profilestudio
description: ProfileStudio: design, preview and publish a GitHub profile README: SVG cards with live stats (profile signal, selected work, language stack, toolkit, contribution heatmap), 13 themes (terminal with Linux distro variants, code editor, IDE, Vim, notebook, classic 90s desktop, Windows 11, macOS, browser, SQL console, git log, handheld console, CRT) in light and dark, an optional animated header made from your own image or GIF, a quick or custom setup, and backups you can restore.
